# Spotify: login and fetch all liked songs and all library songs, then intersect by song_id
spotify_password = [c for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]['password']
sp_login = apis.spotify.login(username='anita.burch@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
sp_token = sp_login['access_token']
print('spotify login ok, token_type:', sp_login.get('token_type'))

# fetch liked songs (paginate fully)
liked = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=sp_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-liked_at')
    if not page:
        break
    liked.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('liked_songs_total:', len(liked))
print('liked_sample_titles:', [x['title'] for x in liked[:10]])

# fetch library songs (paginate fully)
lib = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=sp_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-added_at')
    if not page:
        break
    lib.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('library_songs_total:', len(lib))
print('library_sample_titles:', [x['title'] for x in lib[:10]])

liked_ids = {x['song_id'] for x in liked}
lib_ids = {x['song_id'] for x in lib}
common_ids = liked_ids & lib_ids
print('intersection_count:', len(common_ids))

# Build titles list for intersection. Keep order by liked_at descending (since liked list sorted by -liked_at)
common_titles = [x['title'] for x in liked if x['song_id'] in common_ids]
print('common_titles_count:', len(common_titles))
print('common_titles_sample:', common_titles[:20])

# Prepare reply for thread where friend asked for song recommendations
thread_id = 47821
thread = apis.gmail.show_thread(access_token=access_token, email_thread_id=thread_id)
print('Thread emails (from -> email_id):', [(e['sender']['email'], e['email_id'], e['subject']) for e in thread['emails']])

# Song list already computed earlier; rebuild to ensure consistency
# (Re-fetch liked and library quickly to avoid relying on prior variables if needed)
# Login spotify token already exists as sp_token
liked = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=sp_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-liked_at')
    if not page:
        break
    liked.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

lib = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=sp_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-added_at')
    if not page:
        break
    lib.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

liked_ids = {x['song_id'] for x in liked}
lib_ids = {x['song_id'] for x in lib}
common_titles = [x['title'] for x in liked if x['song_id'] in (liked_ids & lib_ids)]

print('Intersection titles count:', len(common_titles))
print('Intersection titles:', common_titles)

# Verification table: title | in_liked | in_library
verification = []
for title in common_titles:
    # find song record in liked by title (assumed unique enough; still check exact id)
    # We'll find first matching title in liked entries that are in intersection.
    rec = next(x for x in liked if x['title']==title and x['song_id'] in lib_ids)
    verification.append({
        'title': title,
        'song_id': rec['song_id'],
        'in_liked': rec['song_id'] in liked_ids,
        'in_library': rec['song_id'] in lib_ids
    })
print('Verification:', verification)

phrase = "Sure thing! Here are some of my favorite songs."
list_str = ', '.join(common_titles)
body = f"{phrase}\n{list_str}"
print('---EMAIL BODY START---')
print(body)
print('---EMAIL BODY END---')

# Identify the friend email_id to reply to in the thread: pick the most recent incoming email from friend
# In this thread, Anita is the recipient; so select email whose sender != our email.
our_email='anita.burch@gmail.com'
friend_email_records = [e for e in thread['emails'] if e['sender']['email']!=our_email]
print('friend_email_records:', [(e['email_id'], e['sender']['email']) for e in friend_email_records])
email_id_to_reply = friend_email_records[-1]['email_id']
